description:
Chi-Yeong, who hid his sexual identity and spent a quiet school life, once mustered great courage to confess his feelings in high school—and failed. Over a decade later, Eui-Geon, his long-ago crush, happens to visit Chi-Yeong's small gopchang restaurant as a customer with his friend Jun-Young. Eui-Geon's gaze, seemingly unaware of Chi-Yeong, still fixates on someone else. Chi-Yeong realizes Eui-Geon is also carrying on a failed crush...?

 *“...But you like that person, right?”

“He seems quiet and gentle... Don't you sometimes hear that he's different from what you expected?”* 

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
